content: Change scheduled: Users {{fromCount}} → {{toCount}}  |  Dev Pack will be disabled  |  {{price}}/month

comment.text: Title of a warning component shown when both the user count changes and the Dev Pack add-on is switched off at the end of the current billing period; {{fromCount}} is the current number of users, {{toCount}} is the number of users of the next period, and {{price}} is the formatted monthly cost of the next period.
